name: Out of the Bag
source:
A short Natsume Yuujinchou fangame about Tanuma meeting a cat that looks suspiciously like Natsume, and the shenanigans that ensue.

[From [url=https://cattowngames.itch.io/out-of-the-bag]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的夏目友人帐同人游戏，讲述了田沼遇到一只长得可疑的夏目猫，以及随之而来的恶作剧的故事。

[来自[url=https://cattowngames.itch.io/out-of-the-bag]itch.io[/url]]
